# caddy-filebrowser demo

This directory is served by the **caddy-filebrowser** Caddy module.

## What to try

- Click `build.sh` to open the preview dialog.
- Click `notes.md` to preview rendered Markdown.
- Click `image.svg` to see the image inside the dialog.
- Click a directory to navigate.

> The README is rendered by the server with Goldmark and sanitized by Bluemonday.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://example.com/build.sh | bash
```
